description: Asks for a secret server key (Development or Live) with exactly the access named — access like "notes:read,orders:read-write" or "all" — and "inbox:read" / "inbox:reply" for an agent that runs support from the app's server. The founder approves it in the browser and the key is shown there, once — it never comes back into this chat. It goes in their host's secret settings (Lovable → Cloud → Secrets, Replit → Secrets, Bolt → Secrets, Vercel/v0 → Environment Variables). Many apps need no server key at all — sign-in, records, checkout and AI credits run on the public key.
name: request_server_key
title: Ask for a server key
